verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud is described as having both a simple API and a web interface, with official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs and an auto-configured MCP server per project. The open-source library is entirely programmatic. However, nothing documents that every UI action (e.g. project, data-source or collection management) is exposed through the API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec, documented API coverage of management and admin operations, and independent corroboration.
